main_text.p: & fœminin. מְזַלְתָּא, 2.Reg.23.5.constr. מַזְלַת שְׁמַיָּא Sydera, signa cœlestia, Jesa.47.13.
זוף Ch.Increpare, objurgare, reprehēdere. Respondet Hebraeo נָזַף.
נְזוּף נְבַר Ch. Increpatio, objurgatio, reprehensio, נְזוּף חַכִּימָא Increpatio viri sapientis, Eccles.7.6.
מְזִיפִיתָא, מְזוֹפִירִית Ch.Idem: Item Perditio,Exilium, Deut. 28.20. Sed formam habet a זוף.
נזק Ch.Nocuit,laesit,damno affecit: & passive,Laedi,Damno affici. Aphel אַנְזִיק Laedere, damnum afferre, damno afficere, nocere. Ithpehal אִתְנְזִיק Damno affici,Esth.1.8. T.sec.
מְזִיקִין Ch. Daemones, sic dicti, quasi Nocentes, quòd perpetuò hominibus nocere studeât, emph. מְזִיקָיָא.
נזר Ch.Separare se,Separari: Abstinere, continere se à re aliqua. Numer. 6.2. Ithpahel אִתְנְזַר Idem, ibidem,in T.H. Aphel אַנְזֵר Separare se,v.6.
נְזִירָא Ch.Nasiraeus, separatus,qui ex voto à certis rebus abstinet, נֶדֶר נְזִירָא Votum Nasiraei. Plur. cū Aff. Pron. נְזִירָהּ, Nasiraei ejus,Thren.4.7.
נְזִירָא Ch. Nasiraeatus, separatio: Item Coma, Caesaries, Pili, Cantic.5.2. Plur. נְזִירִין.
נַחַל נְחַלָא Ch.Vallis;torrens,per vallem decurrens; Fluvius,flumen,ut Hebr.Plur. נְחַלְיָא, נְחַלִין Torrentes. Syr. ܢܚܠܐ ܢܚܠܝܢ Omnes

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldean and Syriac forms are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; vowel points and Syriac script may contain small errors. The Syriac at the foot of the page is partly illegible.
